== Biography ==
'''John Glasgow''' was baptised at Irvine, Ayrshire, on 5 October 1738. Findmypast's held transcript (SCOT/OPR/BAP/3574782) reports a birth date of 4 September 1738; the MyHeritage-based biography reports 4 October.<ref>MyHeritage, ''Scotland, Births and Baptisms, 1564–1950'', [https://www.myheritage.com/research/record-30226-305754/john-glasgow-in-scotland-births-baptisms record for John Glasgow], film 1041383.</ref> The current profile retains 4 October as uncertain pending comparison with the original register. A second Findmypast derivative transcript, R_685314427, confirms the 5 October baptism and named parents but supplies no exact birth date. The source names Rot Glasgow and Mary Borland. Glasgow-2474 remains the selected father at 86% probable; that profile identification is an inference from the recorded adult-father evidence and compatible local chronology. Borland-1479 remains an unassessed tree-only mother link.<ref name="FMP1738">Findmypast, ''Scotland, Parish Births & Baptisms 1564–1929'', [https://www.findmypast.co.uk/transcript?id=SCOT%2FOPR%2FBAP%2F3574782&tab=this SCOT/OPR/BAP/3574782], OPR 595/1: John Glasgow, birth 4 September 1738, baptism 5 October 1738, father Rot Glasgow, mother Mary Borland; transcript captured 3 September 2026.</ref><ref name="FMP1738R">[https://www.findmypast.co.uk/transcript?id=R_685314427&tab=this Findmypast transcript R_685314427], John Glasgow, baptism 5 October 1738 at Irvine; indexed birth year 1738; parents Robert Glasgow and Mary Borland; saved 24 October 2026. This derivative gives no exact birth date; original register not inspected.</ref>

A separate indexed baptism entry for John Glasgow on 10 October 1736 at Irvine names Robert Glasgow and Mary Borland. It is a distinct recorded event from the 1738 baptism, but the surviving derivatives do not determine whether it represents an earlier same-name child or an indexing/transcription problem. The newly saved Findmypast transcript R_685315512 matches the held 1736 transcript SCOT/OPR/BAP/3574593; it is another derivative report of that event, not independent register evidence.<ref name="FMP1736R">[https://www.findmypast.co.uk/transcript?id=R_685315512&tab=this Findmypast transcript R_685315512], John Glasgow, baptism 10 October 1736 at Irvine; indexed birth year 1736; parents Robert Glasgow and Mary Borland; saved 24 October 2026. Original register not inspected.</ref> Do not treat the 1736 entry as this profile's baptism, a second proven child, or evidence of a death.
